title: Target transport for ordinary finite reduction
statement: For the constant-completion coefficient data, the target finite-reduced functor admits a natural isomorphism to the same canonical finite quotient model change(projection J A I n) followed by pullback along constantMap F (A / I^(n+1)).

source.place: Tags 03EK, 03EL and 093M; target quotient and scalar-associativity transport

proof.text: Compose the finite target quotient restriction transport with the geometric target projection-model transport.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03EK, 03EL and 093M; composition of target quotient and projection-model transports

lean.statement: theorem ordinaryReducedPull_targetIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) : Nonempty ((pull F (completedMap F A I) ⋙ res (coefficientMap J' A I) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n)) ≅ (change (projection J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))))
